title: Glowing cheese wedge
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='1'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFD23F' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFC107' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseSide' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFC107'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E6A800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseBack' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFAB00'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#D48800'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='46' ry='38' fill='url(#glow)' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Cheese wedge - back face -->
  <polygon points='72,28 82,78 22,78' fill='url(#cheeseBack)'/>

  <!-- Cheese wedge - top face -->
  <polygon points='72,28 82,78 22,78 12,40' fill='url(#cheeseTop)'/>
  <polygon points='12,40 22,78 72,28' fill='url(#cheeseTop)'/>

  <!-- Top face highlight edge -->
  <polygon points='12,40 72,28 72,28 12,40' fill='none' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <line x1='12' y1='40' x2='72' y2='28' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='28' x2='82' y2='78' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='12' y1='40' x2='22' y2='78' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Front edge shading -->
  <line x1='12' y1='40' x2='22' y2='78' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='3'/>

  <!-- Cheese holes on top face -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='45' r='5' fill='#E6A800' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='45' r='3.5' fill='#D48800'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='52' r='4' fill='#E6A800' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#D48800'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='60' r='3.5' fill='#E6A800' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='60' r='2' fill='#D48800'/>

  <!-- Cheese hole on front face -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='65' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#CC8800'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='65' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#AA7000'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#CC8800'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#AA7000'/>

  <!-- Small sparkle highlights -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#FFFDE0'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFFDE0'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='74' r='1.2' fill='#FFFDE0'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='35' r='1' fill='#FFFDE0'/>

  <!-- Sparkle crosses -->
  <path d='M50,18 L50,24 M47,21 L53,21' stroke='#FFFDE0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M85,50 L85,56 M82,53 L88,53' stroke='#FFFDE0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M10,70 L10,75 M7.5,72.5 L12.5,72.5' stroke='#FFFDE0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
